profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Microsoft
profile.summary: Self-motivated Software Engineer with experience using JavaScript, React and Node.JS. Interested in a role where I can grow and apply my knowledge and skills in a collaborative environment with a transparent and emotionally intelligent team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Partnered closely with our product managers, product designers, and key business leaders to consistently deliver 3-4 features to production each PI.

• Helped lead automation of task creation for account managers. By converting 30 day batch job task creation to real time task creation through eventing. Providing a smoother user experience for Account managers and increasing task completion times by 30%.

• Played a key role in updating 6 repositories, converting code from ExtJS to React. This improved component reusability, scalability, and maintainability and positively impacted 10+ engineering teams.

• Adhered to version control best practices through the implementation of atomic commits, effective branch utilization, and rigorous code reviews. Following these best practices allowed my team to maintain a clean source control workflow reducing the amount of unused branches and allowing us to easily coordinate production deployments.

• Led the testing of feature implementation by walking my team through 5 areas of testing each with 4-5 testing scenarios and provided guidance on how to document our results.

• Leveraged debugging and refactoring experience to quickly pinpoint bugs and enhance 10 code repositories by removing bugs and improving code readability. This led to easier troubleshooting for my team of 5 engineers.

• Volunteered to mentor two recently onboarded engineers for 6 months, offering guidance on software orientation and supporting their professional development within the organization.

• Established and maintained comprehensive documentation encompassing development, troubleshooting, and training referenced by 10+ engineering teams. This contributed to improved onboarding time.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Software Development · Leadership · Full-Stack Development · Strategic Planning · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Agile Methodologies · Back-End Web Development · Communication · JavaScript · Teamwork · TypeScript · Jenkins · Cypress · HTML5 · Node.js · React.js · Git

positions.title: Junior System Developer
positions.description:
• Generated 100K in savings by leading the consolidation of two different client code repositories after one client acquired the other. 

• Automated generation of weekly feed reports by writing and leveraging complex queries and stored 
   procedures, saving company Analysts 3 hours per week in data processing time.

• Introduced the team to better development practices by encouraging communication, requesting feedback, and breaking down tasks into smaller increments.

• Improved legacy code repository by creating documentation, refactoring, applying standard naming conventions, and writing clear and concise comments resulting in easier-to-maintain code and fewer bugs.

• Refined outdated instructional/set-up documentation for new hires, resulting in a swift and streamlined onboarding process.
